components: a short high shoulder turning at a corner
a long diagonal down to the left
a broad clockwise belly closing to a short left tail
strokeOrder: begin at the upper left and draw the short high shoulder to the right, turning down at the corner
without lifting, descend the long diagonal down and left toward the lower centre
without lifting, swing right into the broad clockwise belly and finish with a short tail curving left at the bottom
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 26-frame animation writes ろ in a single pen-down run: the start marker never moves off the upper-left origin across all 26 frames.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana ろ stroke order animation.gif, hiragana ろ, 26 frames, 2.6 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws ろ in one uninterrupted run: a short high shoulder rightward, a corner, a long diagonal down and left, then a broad clockwise belly that closes and finishes with a short left tail. The learner path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans JP subset; handwritten belly width and tail length vary, but the zero-lift order is the same.

notes: The ro of ろく, six. Same tap as ら, on a shape that closes its belly instead of leaving a hook; and distinct from る, whose belly ends in a closed loop.
